newsitem.title: CANADA: Scott Paper concerned about stock rise.
newsitem.headline: Scott Paper concerned about stock rise.

text.p: Scott Paper Ltd president David Erskine said on Monday he is worried about the recent rise in the company's stock price which he thinks is due to speculation about the sale of the company.

"I am glad that our sale process is nearing an end to we can return all our attention to continuing to be the best tissue company in Canada," Scott Paper president David Erskine said in a statement. "However, the increase in our stock's price over the last several days is of some concern to me as we do not necessarily expect to finalize a transaction at or about the new, higher price level."
The planned sale was announced last August.

Kimberly-Clark Corp said in October it was looking for a buyer for its 50.1 percent stake in Scott Paper. The U.S. paper giant said its advisers were looking for a buyer for 100 percent of the company.
